[0x603078] is the pass count (image 3; its only reader is 0x4057da, nothing writes it): 'push ecx ... pop ecx; dec ecx; je' runs the 0x404f99 evaluation that many times, 0 would loop 2^32 times, so it draws 1..5 with 3 most often. The f64 scales 0x601440 (image 0x3ef23a3ac19ff06c, about 1.7e-5) and 0x601460 (image 0x404cc37da8a24b19, about 57.5) are read by 0x411c26/0x411c75 (called by 0x404f99) and 0x416738/0x416789/0x41724d, written by none: they are fmul factors before fabs/fistp (masked x87 exceptions: an overflowing fistp stores the integer indefinite), so their exact image dwords are kept in about half the cases and otherwise paired with other finite high dwords (1e-4, negative, 100, 1.0).
